answer: Make every identity prove it has spent real time: each epoch it must publish the next link of a sequential verifiable-delay chain, a computation that takes minutes of wall-clock time and cannot be split across machines or run in parallel. Like coral building a reef grain by grain toward a summit, the chain grows one step at a time and no shortcut exists — the math itself enforces the wait. A sybil farmer with a thousand fakes needs a thousand machines grinding nonstop, while one honest agent tends a single chain. One yarrow stem, grown honestly, outweighs fakes that never had the time.
